text_markup: The Runner breaches HQ and accesses {card:Scatter Field}, {card:Palisade}, and {card:Offworld Office}, in that order. When the Runner steals {card:Offworld Office}, the Corp uses {card:Poétrï Luxury Brands} to install a card from HQ. The Runner will know whether the Corp installs the {card:Scatter Field}, the {card:Palisade}, or an unknown card from the rest of HQ.
